## Summary of the last run

The page is logically sound. The definition, the local characterization, the invertibility theorem, the prime factorization theorem, and the class group results are all correctly proved with appropriate citations. The supplement's claims (finiteness of the class group via Minkowski, class number 2 for $\Z[\sqrt{-5}]$, Claborn's theorem, and the Picard group identification) are all standard and correctly stated. The remark on $\End(I)=A$ versus invertibility is correct: in the local normal domain $k[x,y]_{(x,y)}$ the maximal ideal has $\End=A$ but is not principal, hence not invertible. No genuine problems found.
